question: What condition and prior worship are attributed to the knowledge addressed to the beautiful-faced one?
premises: The knowledge was worshipped by Brahmā
The knowledge is seized by a curse
The addressee is the beautiful-faced one
inference: The knowledge, though once worshipped by Brahmā, is now afflicted by a curse.
uncertainties: The nature and cause of the curse are not specified
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, the knowledge worshipped by Brahmā is seized by a curse.
